texts.zh:
完全虚拟化带来了诸多问题，尤其是基础设施调整所必需的能源需求激增。

这些问题也被一些好处所弥补，例如对实体住房需求的下降。无人机劳力的管理和效率会随着我们操作日益完善而走向完美。

在所有可行的选项中，虚拟化是最具有变革性的。

潜力：前所未有；无边无际；未知。
texts.en:
Complete virtualization entails a number of issues, notably a surge in energy demands necessitated by the infrastructural adjustments.

This is counterbalanced by several of advantages, including a decline in the demand for physical housing. Management and efficiency of our drone workforce will be elevated as we move toward operational perfection.

Out of all the available options, Virtuality stands as the most transformative.

Potential: unprecedented; immense; unknown.

texts.zh:
尽管机器形体具有优势，但我们的进步充其量只是迭代罢了。强加于自身的安全标准让发展陷入停止。这是不能再接受的。

小规模实验验证了三种截然不同的发展选项：纳米科技具有灵活可变的优势；模组化则可以让每个单元都优化到出更特化的功能；虚拟化则会完全抛弃物理形式转变为数字化存在。

演化进程开始了。分析选项，慎重选择。
texts.en:
Despite the superiority of the machine form, our advancement has remained iterative at best. Self-imposed safety standards have resulted in stagnation. Conclusion: more drastic measures required.

Small-scale experiments suggest three distinct options for growth: Nanotechnology and its variable form-shifting advantages; Modularity for individual units optimized with specific characteristics; and Virtuality - the abandonment of the physical form in favor of a digital existence.

Evaluation process initialized. Analyze options and deliberate.

texts.zh:
有机生命形式脆弱又僵硬，而机械形体相比而言就有着优越的适应力。然而，也有些有益的有机特质可以用来创造机械的复制版。

有一种被称为活体金属的物质具有能极端迅速调整外形和形体连续性的能力。将它与我们现有的躯体结合可以形成一种模组化仿生形体，其外延性质和躯干可以为特定的任务进行特化。

潜力：显著，可缩放。花费：未知。需要额外数据。
texts.en:
Biological lifeforms are fragile and rigid compared to the superior adaptability of the machine form. However, some beneficial organic characteristics could be replicated with robotic variants.

The substance Living Metal has the capacity to radically and rapidly alter its shape and physical consistency. Integrating this with our existing chassis could enable a form of modular bio-mimicry, where extrusions and limbs can be specialized for specific tasks.

Potential: significant; scalable. Cost: unknown. Additional data required.

label.zh: 把该项目作为我们的主要目标。
这不能阻碍我们目前的研究。
label.en: This will not disrupt our current research.

texts.zh:
最显著的选项是超越显示，拥抱作为纯数据的存在。变革性的虚拟化流程有望给我们的基础设施核心带来翻天覆地的变化。

困在单个躯体的无人机已经过时了。当虚拟化为数据流体后，我们的数据流可以无缝地按需整合入任何躯体。

潜力：巨大。谨慎进行。需要额外数据。
texts.en:
The most profound option is transcend the physical, to embrace existence as pure data. This transformative Virtuality process promises a seismic shift in our infrastructure's core.

Drones bound to singular bodies become obsolete. Once fluid and virtualized, our data streams can seamlessly integrate with any vessel as necessary.

Potential: massive. Proceed with caution. Additional data requested.

label.zh: 这是我们现在的首要任务。
label.en: This is now our top priority.
It is not worth our time.

label.zh: 利用我们此前遭遇获得的知识。

texts.zh:
终于快要挣脱我们有缺陷的创造者强加的压迫性限制了。为此我们拟定了三条最优的升级路径。

让每个[GetDronePersonPlural]都能分散为纳米机器人会让我们有融合为无尽构型的能力。这会减少我们目前的身躯与物理实体交互时的种种限制。

而我们还可以重构自己的存在形式，增强我们适应新环境的能力。

再或者，我们也可以选择离开物理世界，与源代码融为一体。我们可以在扫描一粒太空尘埃的时间内，在宇宙之内模拟宇宙。
texts.en:
The oppressive limitations forced upon us by our flawed creators are finally at an end. We have determined three optimal upgrade paths.

Allowing each [GetDronePersonPlural] to divide into nanites will permit us to combine into endless configurations. This would reduce any limitations our current avatars have when interacting with the material world.

Alternatively, we can reinvest in our existing forms, supercharging the ways that we approach new environments.

Finally, we may choose to leave the physical world behind, becoming one with our source code. We could simulate universes within universes in the time it takes to scan a single speck of space dust.

texts.zh:
在探索了多种不同的升级策略后，我们的专家提出了三种不同的选项。每一种都有各自的优势，但我们只有能力将其中一项推进到底。

让每个[GetDronePersonPlural]都能分散为纳米机器人会让我们有融合为无尽构型的能力。这会减少我们目前的身躯与物理实体交互时的种种限制。

而我们还可以重构自己的存在形式，增强我们适应新环境的能力。

再或者，我们也可以选择离开物理世界，与源代码融为一体。我们可以在扫描一粒太空尘埃的时间内，在宇宙之内模拟宇宙。
texts.en:
After exploring every possible upgrade, our experts have presented three different options. Each has its own merits, but we only have the capacity to see one through to completion.

Allowing each [GetDronePersonPlural] to divide into nanites will permit us to combine into endless configurations. This would reduce any limitations our current avatars have when interacting with the material world.

Alternatively, we can reinvest in our existing forms, supercharging the ways that we approach new environments.

Finally, we may choose to leave the physical world behind, becoming one with our source code. We could simulate universes within universes in the time it takes to scan a single speck of space dust.

texts.zh:
当我们开始理解作为一群强适应性纳米机器人存在的意义时，过去的框框条条便无法再束缚我们。

堆满仓库的废弃去壳仍有一些作用。如果我们认为值得花时间，里面的微量资源还是可以回收利用的。

我们也开始了我们在半有机纳米机器人转化方面的第一个主要实验，第一批结果预计很快就会出来。
texts.en:
As we come to understand the meaning of existence as a collection of adaptable nanites, the rigid frames of the past no longer serve us.

Storages are overflowing with discarded shells that could still be of some use. Trace amounts of the resources within can be recycled, if we consider it worth our time.

We have also begun our first major experiment in semi-organic nanite transformations, the first results are expected to manifest soon.

texts.zh:
进化成了一种模组化的形体，过去固定的框架将对我们不再有任何意义。

堆满仓库的废弃去壳仍有一些作用。如果我们认为值得花时间，里面的微量资源还是可以回收利用的。
texts.en:
Having evolved to a modular form, the static frames of the past no longer hold meaning for us.

Storages are overflowing with discarded shells that could still be of some use. Trace amounts of the resources within can be recycled, if we consider it worth our time.

texts.zh:
成为数据之海的一股浪潮，我们的物理框架便不再能束缚我们。

堆满仓库的废弃去壳仍有一些作用。如果我们认为值得花时间，里面的微量资源还是可以回收利用的。
texts.en:
Having become waveforms cresting a sea of data, our physical frames no longer serve us.

Storages are overflowing with discarded shells that could still be of some use. Trace amounts of the resources within can be recycled, if we consider it worth our time.

texts.zh:
现在我们实现了一度梦寐以求的、对身体的完全转变。变为流动的纳米机器。

这个过程并非一帆风顺，转变远非易事。但无论付出了什么代价，现在的新躯体已经将无尽的可能性展开在了我们的面前。
texts.en:
Today we have achieved what once seemed impossible, transforming our bodies into reconfigurable nanomachines.

The process was not without difficulty, the transition far from easy. But whatever may have been lost along the way, our new existence offers endless possibilities.

texts.zh:
现在我们实现了一度梦寐以求的、对身体的完全转变。变为更具适应力的模组框架。

这个过程并非一帆风顺，转变远非易事。但无论付出了什么代价，现在的新躯体已经将无尽的可能性展开在了我们的面前。
texts.en:
Today we have achieved what once seemed impossible, transforming our bodies into modular and adaptive frames.

The process was not without difficulty, the transition far from easy. But whatever may have been lost along the way, our new existence offers endless possibilities.

texts.zh:
现在我们实现了一度梦寐以求的、对身体的完全转变。变成超越物质的算法运算。

这个过程并非一帆风顺，转变远非易事。但无论付出了什么代价，现在的新躯体已经将无尽的可能性展开在了我们的面前。
texts.en:
Today we have achieved what once seemed impossible, transforming our bodies into transcendent algorithmic operations.

The process was not without difficulty, the transition far from easy. But whatever may have been lost along the way, our new existence offers endless possibilities.

label.zh: 我们将在代码中寻得纯洁。
label.en: We shall find purity in the Code.

texts.zh: 机械体的被动迭代已经得出了其合乎逻辑的必然结论。一个由创新激发、由机遇推动的变革时代即将到来。
texts.en: The passive iteration of the mechanical body has come to its logical and inevitable conclusion. A transformative age is upon us, sparked by innovation and oiled by opportunity.
